name: Hoisler's
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Hoisler’s in Ehrwald – a cozy alpine retreat nestled in the heart of the **Tirol**!** Indulge in our **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh berries or a dollop of **Apfelmus**. Savor hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a rustic mix of potatoes, onions, and crispy bacon, or try our **Kaspressknödel**—creamy cheese dumplings that melt in your mouth. After a day of hiking in the **Karwendel** or skiing on the slopes of **Ehrwald**, warm up with a steaming **Kaffee** or a glass of **Tiroler Apfelwein**. Our **Hausmannskost** (homestyle cooking) and fresh mountain air make every meal an experience. Come for the food, stay for the views—**Hoisler’s** is where **Tirol**’s warmth meets your table! 🏔️✨ --- *Visit us in Ehrwald*
